column1: Bring a large pot with slightly less water than usual to a boil so it gets extra starchy. Add the salt.
Cook the pasta until al dente according to the package.
While it cooks, finely grate the Pecorino on a microplane into a light, fluffy pile (about 3 cups).
Toast the peppercorns in a small skillet over medium-high heat until fragrant, cool briefly, then grind coarsely.
Save 1 1/2 cups of the pasta water and drain the pasta.
Return the pasta to the pot off the heat with 1/3 cup pasta water. Add a third of the cheese, 2 tsp pepper, and a splash of water and stir hard.
Keep adding splashes of water and the next third of cheese, stirring vigorously until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Hold back a little cheese for topping.
Divide among bowls, top with the reserved cheese and a pinch of pepper, and serve immediately.
